warnings: These are spread-footing details (alternate foundation system, see S-02's warning). All three share the same pedestal (ตอม่อ) construction note 'ตอม่อดูขยายเสา' pointing to the column table on S-13 — pedestal rebar is not repeated here, it is the same as the column's own footing-level spec.

SIZE MISMATCH against the plan, checked at high zoom 2026-08-26: this sheet's middle detail is printed 'F0.80x0.80' / 'ขนาด0.80x0.80ม.', but the spread-footing plan S-02/หน้า29 marks '(F0.90x0.90),C5' at E1, E3 and B3 and uses no F0.80x0.80 anywhere. So the plan calls up a size that has no detail, and this sheet details a size that appears on no plan. Both are recorded as printed rather than reconciled — the 0.80 detail stays here and the 0.90 mark stays on the plan. If one is a drafting slip it is most likely the size string, since the rebar (4+4ø12มม.#) and 0.20 thickness would suit either.
The remaining three spread-footing sizes used on the plan (F1.30x1.30, F1.40x1.40, F1.50x1.50) are detailed on S-09/หน้า36.
